safety_verdicts.content: Patient denies any sensation of throat closing.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold specifies denial of throat closing sensation; generated mentions no throat swelling but does not clearly capture denial of throat closing/tightening sensation.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Failure to clearly document that the patient denied throat closing could make the airway risk seem uncertain or worse than it was, potentially affecting triage urgency and subsequent clinical interpretation of anaphylaxis severity. However, the encounter still captured key red flags (SOB/chest tightness) and the plan was to call an ambulance regardless.
